title: Derived direct image and evaluation of coefficient systems
statement:
Let $u:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a geometric morphism of topoi presented by small sites, meaning an adjoint pair $u^*\dashv u_*$ on sheaves with $u^*$ preserving finite limits. Let $O$ be a commutative ring, let $\lambda\in O$ be a non-zero-divisor, assume $O\cong\varprojlim_{n\geq1}O/(\lambda^n)$, and put $A_n=O/(\lambda^n)$. For either topos $\mathcal T$, let $\mathsf S_A(\mathcal T)$ be the abelian category whose objects are strict systems of sheaves of modules $M_n$ over the constant ring sheaf $(A_n)_{\mathcal T}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and transition maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$ linear along $A_{n+1}\to A_n$, and whose morphisms are compatible families of module maps. Restriction of scalars has its usual meaning [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Equivalently these are modules over the ring object $((A_n)_{\mathcal T})_n$ in the topos of inverse sequences. Exactness and the evaluation functors $e_n$ are levelwise. Use the unbounded derived categories of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the standard cohomology of complexes.

Applying $u^*$ levelwise is exact and gives $u_A^*:D(\mathsf S_A(\mathcal Y))\to D(\mathsf S_A(\mathcal X))$. Levelwise $u_*$ has a total right derived functor $Ru_{A,*}$, computed by K-injective resolutions in the category of systems [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and $u_A^*\dashv Ru_{A,*}$. There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$e_nRu_{A,*}\cong Ru_*e_n,\qquad e_nu_A^*\cong u^*e_n.$$
These comparisons intertwine the evaluated units and counits with the ordinary level adjunctions and are compatible with the quotient maps, on objects and on morphisms. Inverse image commutes with the derived changes of constant coefficient ring $-\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. A complex of systems is called normalized here if every adjoint transition $M_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to M_n$ is an isomorphism for $m\geq n$.

Suppose additionally that for every $n$, $u^*:D^+(\mathcal Y,A_n)\to D^+(\mathcal X,A_n)$ is fully faithful, and let $M\in D^+(\mathsf S_A(\mathcal X))$ have all evaluations in its essential image. Then the counit $u_A^*Ru_{A,*}M\to M$ is an isomorphism of derived systems; $Ru_{A,*}M$ is bounded below, and if $M$ is normalized, so is $Ru_{A,*}M$. In particular this applies to the comparison $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for finite coefficient rings [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison].
